title: Persian Culinary Culture
summary: Persian: saffron and turmeric, rice, yogurt.
origins: Persian cuisine reflects middle east geography, trade routes, and home cooking traditions passed through generations.
history: Shared plates, warm spices, and balance of grain, legume, and herb.
teaching: Toast spices, use yogurt and tahini for richness, finish with fresh herb and pomegranate acid.
Sumac, zaatar, bulgur, chickpeas, and flatbread are pantry anchors.
Signature pairing: saffron and turmeric + rice + yogurt.
